ios.desc:
Most men don’t realise it, but after age 30, testosterone levels begin to decline — slowly, silently, and often with noticeable effects. You might feel more tired than usual, lose motivation to train, struggle with sleep, or find your mood dipping for no obvious reason. These changes can be subtle at first, but over time, they add up.

Mojo helps you spot the patterns, take control, and feel like yourself again. It’s not about gimmicks or shortcuts — it’s about understanding how your daily habits affect your hormones, energy, and overall vitality.

Track the habits that matter
Mojo gives you fast, frictionless daily check-ins for the key lifestyle factors that impact male hormones — including sleep, stress, libido, energy, training, alcohol, supplements, and more. The process takes less than 60 seconds a day and helps you stay consistent without overthinking it.

Every data point you enter is stored locally on your device. There’s no account to create, and no personal information ever leaves your phone. Your health is your business — we keep it that way.

Understand how your habits affect your health
Mojo doesn’t just collect data — it helps you learn from it. Your inputs are analysed and distilled into a daily vitality score, so you can get a simple, high-level view of how you’re doing. Over time, Mojo surfaces meaningful correlations between your lifestyle and your score — helping you identify what’s helping or hurting your recovery, drive, and energy.

You’ll start to see things like:
	•	How late-night alcohol impacts your mood the next day
	•	Whether consistent sleep boosts your libido
	•	How training too hard without recovery tanks your energy

Mojo turns gut feelings into clear, measurable insights — so you can make smarter choices without the guesswork.

Built for consistency and momentum
Improving your hormones and performance is all about consistency. Mojo helps you stay on track with streak tracking, weekly summaries, and motivational nudges based on your real data. It’s not just about logging — it’s about building habits that compound over time.

You’ll see how your average vitality is trending week to week, and get rewarded for showing up — even on days where you’re not at your best.

Powered by science, not fluff
Forget the noise. Mojo gives you concise, referenced articles that explain the science behind how lifestyle factors like sleep, diet, stress, and exercise affect testosterone. No clickbait, no bro-science — just clear, actionable info

quotes.text:
A lot of friends in their 30s were getting bloodwork done and realising their testosterone was low. Energy, mood, libido — all below baseline. But outside of Reddit threads and sketchy supplements, there’s no simple, science-backed way to actually track and improve the habits that affect it.

So I built Mojo — a minimal, private iOS app that helps men log the key lifestyle factors that influence testosterone and overall vitality.

Each day, you check in with a few quick sliders: sleep, stress, libido, energy, workouts, diet, alcohol, supplements, etc. It takes under 30 seconds.

From that, Mojo generates a daily vitality score based on your inputs and shows weekly trends across pillars like physical recovery, hormonal balance, and mental state. Over time, it surfaces meaningful correlations (e.g. poor sleep → lower libido → reduced score), helping users understand what’s dragging them down or lifting them up.

You also get concise, referenced tips and articles — designed to cut through the noise and explain how sleep, stress, and training actually affect hormones. No fluff, no bro science.

The app is fully local:
 • No account creation
 • No server
 • No third-party data collection
 • Optional Apple Health integration (for syncing workouts and sleep)

Mojo is designed to be low-friction but genuinely useful — a tool for building consistency and insight over time.

It’s available now on the App Store for a one-time £4.99.
